evidence:
Measured on the frozen bytes with read-only parsers (Python 3 tomllib/json/ast, Git Bash 'bash -n', Node v24.19.0 'node --check'; nothing written into .qc-cache).

1. TOML: tomllib.load succeeds for task/task.toml, task/tests/scoring.toml and all five task/tests/*/*/judge.toml. Criterion counts: render 1, constraints 2, functional 43, polish 6, visual 3 (55 ids, no duplicate). Every criterion has id, non-empty description, positive weight and type in binary|likert; the three visual likert criteria carry 'points'. In each judge.toml the parsed [judge] table (mode, timeout, isolated, prompt_template = "prompt.md", mcp_servers, judge = "claude-code"; no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight) and the [scoring] table equal the frozen template's by value. Each prompt_template target exists and contains '{criteria}'; the only other brace placeholder is '{app_context}', which tests/test.sh:195-201 substitutes from /tests/app_context.md (present).

2. task.toml differs from the template only in the CHANGE_ME identity/metadata fields (diff shows lines 5-7, 10-12, 14-15); the [verifier.env] block and timeouts are unchanged. tests/scoring.toml, tests/test.sh, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/Dockerfile, tests/.dockerignore and environment/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the template (cmp).

3. Shell: 'bash -n' exits 0 for task/solution/solve.sh and task/tests/test.sh; both begin '#!/bin/bash'. A byte scan of every file under task/ found no '\r' byte and no UTF-8 BOM anywhere. The workspace .gitattributes line 66 ('projects/colderwater-playground-devtools/** -text') keeps that tree out of autocrlf conversion, and the worktree copies of test.sh and solve.sh also contain 0 CR bytes. test.sh has no line-leading shell 'exec' (only 'find ... -exec chmod', test.sh:86).

4. JSON/Python: environment/assets/seed_data.json, solution/app/package.json, package-lock.json and tsconfig.json load with json.load; score.py and restart_mcp.py pass ast.parse.

5. Reference entry: 'node --check' passes for solution/app/server.js (the file tests/test.sh:68 requires and test.sh:97/111 launches), for the shipped bundle public/assets/index.js and for vite.config.mjs. server.js requires only node built-ins plus express and better-sqlite3 (server.js:2-5); both are installed globally at pinned versions in both images (express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1) with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules, the same NODE_PATH test.sh:106 injects. server.js:8 reads DB_PATH, server.js:142 listens on PORT||3000 on 0.0.0.0, server.js:12 answers /api/health, matching test.sh:48 and test.sh:108-109. public/index.html references /assets/index.js and /assets/index.css, both present. solve.sh resolves '$(dirname $0)/app', asserts server.js exists and copies it to /app.

6. Run evidence (hashes verified against raw-evidence-index.json): all 16 qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict artifacts match their recorded SHA256. run_golden.sh installs with the task's solve.sh and starts 'node /app/server.js' as uid 65534 under env -i with DB_PATH/NODE_PATH and cwd /tmp; results/runtime.json records cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing true with pageErrors [], and results/restart.json shows the saved snippet at revision 2 after a real process restart. So the reference entry was observed to start and serve under the test.sh launch shape.

Notes (not defects in this row):
(a) 'node --check solution/app/src/custom-editor.js' reports 'SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module' because package.json declares "type": "commonjs". That file is ESM bundler source consumed by Vite, never loaded by Node at runtime; it parses cleanly as a module ('node --input-type=module --check' exits 0). No runtime effect.
(b) Four of the six hosted-run artifacts listed in the evidence index (the Rc3y2sT result.json, verifier/reward.json, verifier/scored/reward-details.json, verifier/gates/reward-details.json) do not match their recorded SHA256 as raw bytes in the worktree; they match exactly after CRLF->LF normalisation, i.e. the worktree checkout converted line endings. Content is equivalent (reward.json reads reward 0.9833, graded 1), but the index should record hashes of the bytes as stored or the path should be marked -text. The two 2KqFPi3 artifacts match raw.
(c) Limits of the measurement: the scripted golden run was in the agent image on the previous commit's bytes (the index states the only later change is one paragraph in each prompt.md), not through tests/test.sh in the verifier image, and no configured judge run exists for these bytes. The hosted Oracle run that did go through the byte-identical template test.sh was on an earlier candidate. This row's own procedure (parse, bash -n, LF, entry parse) is fully measured; a verifier-image launch of these exact bytes is not, and belongs to the runtime evidence records rather than to this parse check.
(d) The input SHA256 128f56cd... was preserved as assigned; I did not recompute it because the manifest's hashing recipe is not part of this row's sources.

Adversarial checks: a broken variant (CRLF in test.sh, a judge.toml with a duplicate id or missing '{criteria}', a server.js requiring a package absent from the verifier image) would be caught by the checks above and none is present. A conforming alternative app is not penalised by anything in this row: test.sh only requires /app/server.js and a response on port 3000.
